title: Injuries and the Med Bay
summary: The injured have about a minute. A Med Bay or Medevac gets them to safety.
text:
When a building falls, or a predator catches someone outdoors, people are left **lying injured** with about a minute to live.

- A **Med Bay** stops anyone injured within its reach from getting worse, while it has power, and its stretcher crews bring them in one at a time, fully healed. Medics on staff make that quicker
- The **Medevac** (Vehicle Bay) is a fast ambulance: it drives to anyone injured within its reach, takes up to four aboard and brings them in to a Med Bay or the nearest home. Send it in behind your guns

Homes near a Med Bay also get medical care, and the people living there live longer. The research Colony Medicine helps the injured hold on longer.
